Chapter 151. Limited Sales, Excise, and Use Tax. A tax is imposed on each sale of a taxable
item in this state at the rate set by this chapter. A use tax is imposed on the storage, use, or
consumption in this state of a taxable item purchased, leased, or rented from a retailer, at the
rate provided in Section 151.051 of this chapter. A taxing unit such as a city, county, or
special district may adopt a local sales and use tax up to the combined local cap allowed under
this chapter, in addition to the state rate.

Chapter 171. Franchise Tax. Each taxable entity that does business in this state or that is
chartered or organized in this state is subject to the franchise tax imposed by this chapter,
computed on the entity's margin as defined by this chapter. An entity whose total revenue for
the period does not exceed the no-tax-due threshold set by the comptroller is not required to
pay the tax, but must still file the required information report under Section 171.204.
